post.originalText:
I asked Claude Opus 5.5 to simulate 3 double pendulums started 1 billionth of a radian apart.

For 12.7 seconds they move as one. Then they split.

Bug or chaos? Energy drifted 0.000000007% in 40 s, and 1000× tighter precision gave the same 12.7 s.

What should it simulate next? https://t.co/Pz49FrTAns
